newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France May cargo FTKs up 10.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Air France May cargo FTKs up 10.2 pct.

text.p: Air France said it carried 396.7 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK) last month, a 10.2 percent rise on May 1996.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
The overall cargo load factor in May 1997 was up four percentange points on the same month in 1996 at 67.6 percent, the airline said.
In April-May 1997, the first two months of its current financial year - which runs until March 31 1998 - Air France transported 824.0 million FTK, up 10.6 percent on April-May 1996.
Overall cargo load factor in the two months in question, was up was up 4.1 percentage points on the same period the previous year at 68.5 percent, the airline added.
